description.value:
A sleeveless vest of layered pre-Fall ballistic fibre with foam trauma pads front and back, pulled from an evidence locker or a cop's closet two centuries ago and re-stitched a dozen times since. Light enough to wear under a coat all day; stiff enough to stop a slug. The sidearm's answer.

No signature, no harmonization. Zips up the front.

⚙️ Mechanical Effects

  • Armor: Light
  • Defense: Guard +3
  • Requires: Fitting (trained)
  • Tier: II
  • Cost: 90 Nonlethal marks

⟡ Inlaid (+1). Hex-inlay along the working edge.

  • +1 on each of its defense bonuses → Guard +3 (rank-scaled like all armor: Trained half, Proficient full).
  • Grade raises it to Tier II · free to wield.

item.signature: Pre-Fall fibre that still remembers what it was for.
